assets.name: 旅人兜帽
assets.initial_generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: FlatWorld 2D overhead sandbox RPG inventory equipment sprite, first art-direction approval sample.
Style: low-saturation, semi-realistic retro pixel art, LOW logical pixel count. Natural believable proportions and functional construction. Draw as one authentic hand-placed 32x32 pixel sprite enlarged 32 times with nearest-neighbor to a 1024x1024 PNG presentation; every painted step should follow a uniform coarse square-pixel grid. Large hard-edged pixel clusters, only 12-18 opaque colors. Clear iconic silhouette, sparse detail. Upper-left light, midtone plus one main shadow and small restrained hard highlight. Muted earthy colors, no pure-black thick outline. Nothing painterly, glossy 3D, smooth, fuzzy or vector-like. Preserve visible large pixels even at this large presentation size.
Composition: ONE isolated item centered, 3/4 view mildly turned left and slightly viewed from above, with about 10-15% clear transparent margin. No floor, no cast shadow, no background, no display card, no text or labels, no watermark, no border, no grid drawn on top. No person, face, skin, hair or mannequin. Real transparent RGBA background; do not paint a checkerboard. The empty openings are transparent where you could see through. Design for readability as a small inventory icon, not a large detailed illustration.
Primary request: Redraw the existing Traveler Hood (旅人兜帽) as an empty practical medieval traveler cloth hood. Preserve its recognizable muted warm umber-brown cloth, rounded slightly pointed crown, deep open face aperture, broad folded rim and short shoulder cowl. Coarse woven cloth indicated through only broad pixel planes and 2 or 3 folds; a tiny dull leather tie at the base, not decorative jewelry. No fantasy horns, fur, cape, armor or body. Dark interior lining is visible on the far back inside, but the central face opening must be actually empty/transparent. Plain fabric should look matte and lived-in, never metallic.
assets.refinement_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: genuine very low-resolution pixel game inventory icon.
Image 1 is the edit target, the 旅人兜帽 equipment sample.
Make only one targeted change: DRASTICALLY SIMPLIFY the pixel resolution and detail. Keep exactly this item's identity, construction, silhouette, muted colors, viewing angle, upper-left light and transparency. Do not add objects.
The source has too much detail. Repaint the whole object as an authentic 32x32-pixel sprite shown at a large nearest-neighbor magnification. All pixel steps are LARGE equally sized square blocks on ONE uniform 32-column by 32-row grid. Occupied silhouette about 26x27 logical pixels. There must be no micro pixels or different finer grids. Use at most 16 opaque flat colors; only a base color, one shadow and one restrained highlight per material. Merge all little scratches, stitching, texture noise, tiny rivets and grain into a few broad solid clusters. Broad readable faceted shading. Plain matte cloth, restrained iron highlights, or one clear glass highlight as appropriate. No gradients, anti-aliasing, dither, flecks, color noise, painterly texture, soft edges, 3D shine, black thick outlines, text, frame, ground or shadow.
Keep one centered empty piece of equipment with no human, no face, skin, hair or mannequin. Retain genuinely transparent RGBA background and open aperture. No visible checkerboard. This is a coarse 32x32 sprite displayed large, not a detailed illustration with a pixelation filter.
assets.refinement_input_role: Generated first-pass sample, identity and composition reference; simplified using image_gen edit.
